#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
LL n, A[20], B[20], ans;
#define FOR(i,a,b) for(int i=(a);i<=(b);i++)

void explore(int pos, LL current, LL cost) {
    if (cost >= ans) return;
    if (pos == 0) {
        if (current == 0) ans = cost;
        return;
    }
    int t = current / A[pos];
    int delta_neg = abs(t) - 1;
    if (t < 0) delta_neg = -delta_neg;
    int delta_pos = abs(t) + 1;
    if (t < 0) delta_pos = -delta_pos;

    explore(pos - 1, current - t * B[pos], cost + abs(t) * pos);
    explore(pos - 1, current - delta_neg * B[pos], cost + abs(delta_neg) * pos);
    explore(pos - 1, current - delta_pos * B[pos], cost + abs(delta_pos) * pos);
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; i++) B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    A[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= 16; i++) A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10;
    scanf("%lld", &n);
    LL temp = n;
    int digits = 0;
    while (temp) {
        digits++;
        temp /= 10;
    }
    ans = 1e18;
    explore(digits, n, 0);
    explore(digits, B[digits + 1] - n, digits + 1);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
